texto: What accuracy does RAPTOR reach on QuALITY when paired with GPT-4?
respuesta_oraculo: 82.6% (RAPTOR with GPT-4 on QuALITY, test set), a new state of the art over the previous best of 62.3%.

citas.cita: RAPTOR paired with GPT-4 sets a new state-of-the-art with an accuracy of 82.6%

notas: Tabla 7: 82.6 % (RAPTOR+GPT-4, test) frente a 62.3 % anterior. Con GPT-3 en dev da 62.4 %: otra cifra, no mezclar.

texto: What accuracy has been reported for Hindsight on LongMemEval?
respuesta_oraculo: 91.4% with Gemini-3 Pro, 89.0% with OSS-120B and 83.6% with OSS-20B on LongMemEval (S setting, 500 questions).

citas.cita: Hindsight with OSS-120B achieves 89.0% overall accuracy, and with Gemini-3 Pro achieves 91.4%
lifts overall accuracy from 39.0% to 83.6% over a full-context baseline on LongMemEval

notas: Tabla 3 de Hindsight: 91.4/89.0/83.6. El 91.4 usa Gemini-3 Pro solo como generador de la respuesta final; la memoria corre con OSS-120B.

texto: What win rate does LightRAG have against the naive retrieval baseline overall on the Agriculture dataset?
respuesta_oraculo: 67.6% for LightRAG against 32.4% for NaiveRAG (Agriculture, Overall row of Table 1).
notas: Tabla 1, fila Overall de Agriculture: 67.6 % vs 32.4 %.

texto: Which paper builds a tree by repeatedly grouping pieces of text and summarising each group, so questions can be answered at different levels of detail?
respuesta_oraculo: RAPTOR (Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval).

citas.cita: recursively embedding, clustering, and summarizing chunks of text

notas: Resumen: «recursively embedding, clustering, and summarizing chunks of text».

texto: Which paper answers broad questions about a whole collection of texts by first summarising groups of closely connected entities?
respuesta_oraculo: GraphRAG (From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization).

citas.cita: pregenerate community summaries for all groups of closely related entities

notas: El paper habla de pregenerar resúmenes de comunidad (Leiden) sobre grupos de entidades relacionadas; confirmado el sentido. Verificar la frase exacta del fragmento con Ctrl+F.

texto: Which paper skips retrieval altogether by loading the whole knowledge base into the model's precomputed state?
respuesta_oraculo: Cache-Augmented Generation (CAG), from the paper Don't Do RAG.
notas: Resumen: «preloading all relevant resources»; «bypasses real-time retrieval»; caché KV.

texto: How many turns does a LoCoMo conversation have?
respuesta_oraculo: The LoCoMo paper says about 300 turns per conversation; another paper describes the same conversations as about 600 turns each, and a third as 27.2 sessions of about 21 turns each.
notas: Verificado: LoCoMo dice 300 turnos (Tabla 1: 304.9); Tabla 5: 19.3 sesiones y 15.8 turnos por sesión; 2603.02473 dice «approximately 600 turns each»; 2511.01448 «27.2 sessions, each with about 21 turns».

texto: What accuracy does Zep get on LoCoMo?
respuesta_oraculo: It depends on the paper: an overall J of 65.99 in the Mem0 paper, 59.22 in the MemOS paper, and 40.30 (Llama-3.1-70B) or 44.76 (GPT-4o-mini) accuracy in LiCoMemory.
notas: Mem0 paper, Tabla 2: Zep 65.99 (Mem0 66.88, Mem0g 68.44). MemOS: Zep 59.22. LiCoMemory: 40.30 (Llama-3.1-70B) y 44.76 (GPT-4o-mini).

texto: Do the papers agree on whether Zep or Mem0 scores higher on LongMemEval?
respuesta_oraculo: No. In the MemOS paper Mem0 is higher (66.4 against 63.8 for Zep), and in LiCoMemory with GPT-4o-mini too (62.60 against 58.60), but in LiCoMemory with Llama-3.1-70B Zep is higher (60.20 against 56.80).
notas: MemOS Tabla 4: Mem0 66.4 vs Zep 63.8. LiCoMemory: GPT-4o-mini Mem0 62.60 vs Zep 58.60; Llama-3.1-70B Zep 60.20 vs Mem0 56.80. Todo confirmado.

texto: Which papers in the collection mention UltraDomain?
respuesta_oraculo: Three papers: MemoRAG (which introduces UltraDomain), LightRAG (which uses four of its datasets) and E2GraphRAG (which says it does not adopt it).

citas.cita: four datasets from the UltraDomain benchmark
We do not adopt the UltraDomain

notas: Confirmado en los tres: MemoRAG «introducing the UltraDomain benchmark»; LightRAG «four datasets from the UltraDomain benchmark»; E2GraphRAG «We do not adopt the UltraDomain». Que no haya más papers que lo mencionen no lo pude comprobar.

texto: What overall LoCoMo score does the Mem0 paper publish for Mem0, and how does a later paper treat it?
respuesta_oraculo: The Mem0 paper publishes 66.88 overall J; a later paper weights the published category scores by question counts and gets 62.14 instead.

texto: What accuracy do GraphRAG (local) and LightRAG reach on NovelQA with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct according to the E2GraphRAG paper?
respuesta_oraculo: 43.34 for GraphRAG (local) and 38.57 for LightRAG, against 37.27 for RAPTOR and 45.60 for E2GraphRAG (Table 1, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct).
notas: E2GraphRAG Tabla 1 (Qwen2.5-7B): GraphRAG-L 43.34, LightRAG 38.57, RAPTOR 37.27, E2GraphRAG 45.60.

texto: What is the best score reported at the 128K setting in the RULER paper?
respuesta_oraculo: Gemini-1.5-Pro with 94.4 at 128K (GPT-4 reaches 81.2 and GLM4 (9B) 83.1; Table 3).
notas: RULER Tabla 3: Gemini-1.5-Pro 94.4 (mejor a 128K), GPT-4 81.2, GLM4 (9B) 83.1.

texto: Which agent has the highest overall score in the main MemoryAgentBench table?
respuesta_oraculo: GPT-5-mini with a 400K context, with an overall score of 60.6 (Table 3).
notas: MemoryAgentBench Tabla 3: GPT-5-mini (400K) 60.6, el mayor «Overall».

texto: How many documents and how many tokens does the Agriculture dataset have in the LightRAG paper?
respuesta_oraculo: 12 documents and 2,017,886 tokens (Table 4).
notas: LightRAG Tabla 4: Agriculture 12 documentos y 2,017,886 tokens.

texto: Which paper introduces the benchmark called FactConsolidation?
respuesta_oraculo: MemoryAgentBench, which builds FactConsolidation (single-hop and multi-hop) for selective forgetting; other papers only mention it.

citas.cita: FC-SH and FC-MH mean FactConsolidation Single Hop

notas: MemoryAgentBench Tabla 3: «FC-SH and FC-MH mean FactConsolidation Single Hop and FactConsolidation Multi Hop». Que otros cinco papers solo lo mencionen no lo pude comprobar.

texto: Which four abilities does MemoryAgentBench test?
respuesta_oraculo: Accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding and selective forgetting.

citas.cita: accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting

notas: Resumen de MemoryAgentBench: accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding y selective forgetting.
